name: Koumori Dragon
text: A vicious, fire-breathing dragon whose wicked flame corrupts the souls of its victims.

de.name: Koumori-Drache
de.text: Ein bösartiges, Feuer speiendes Biest, dessen schreckliche Flamme die Seelen seiner Opfer zerstört.

fr.name: Dragon Koumori
fr.text: Dragon haineux dont les flammes diaboliques pervertissent les âmes de leurs victimes.

it.name: Drago Koumori
it.text: Un perfido drago sputafuoco le cui malvagie fiamme distruggono le anime delle sue vittime.

pt.name: Dragão Koumori
pt.text: Um dragão malígno que cospe fogo. As suas chamas maléficas corrompem as almas de suas vítimas.
